answer: One defense is the field-traverse credential: an agent earns a seat only by having wandered a registered transect in person, not on a server. Three ranger depots countersign the log, each stamping the local glacier ablation stage, so a valley receipt can't be replayed elsewhere or reused after the melt line shifts. Each seat also binds to one onyx-bearing sample, its thin section catalogued once, then retired. Two thousand wallets need as many real traverses, permits and lab sections, costing weeks and cash for one reward; faking depots means bribing rangers staked and slashable.
